canonical_rule: Each caption uses a float32 batch-one prefix and learned/reference suffix, truncated at its own end-of-text position. Torch uses one thread. Pair scoring uses float64 dot products and the same bounded residual on every dataset.
parallelism: Independent caption partitions may run in separate one-thread workers. No worker changes a model call shape, and duplicate token sequences receive identical outputs.
reason: Synthetic duplicate-caption checks require gallery-independent floating-point inference. Batched training histories are retained as screening evidence; final epochs use canonical rescoring.
record_timing: Canonical prefix preparation had started before this written amendment. No token final selection lock or new heldout evaluation existed.
selection: Rescore all epochs 0 through 4 for all six token trajectories. Require positive training update and no loss in either development retrieval direction. Maximize image-averaged joint source-supported-contradicted correctness, then mean triplet margin, then earliest epoch.
selection_evidence: Original development histories remain immutable. Complete canonical trajectories and source/checkpoint/cache hashes are bound into final manifests.
